Welcome to Word Scramble!

 How to Play: Unscramble the letters to form the correct word. Tap on letters to add them to your guess. Tap a selected letter in the guess area to remove it, or use the backspace button. Long-press backspace to clear your entire guess.

 Scoring:
 You get 10 points for each correct word.

 Clues:
 You start with 5 clues per game session. You can use up to 2 clues per word. In Endless Mode, you earn one clue every 3rounds. A clue inputs the next correct letter where applicable

 Game Modes:
 - Endless: Play as many rounds as you like. Your score is saved when you choose to "Save and Quit".
 - 10 Rounds / 20 Rounds: Complete the set number of rounds. Your score is automatically saved at the end of the game.

 Good luck and have fun!
